## Content

I'll review the P1.7 candidate against the spec, OPUS requirements, and the recorded validation evidence, without changing anything. First I need the rest of the supplied evidence and the implementation around conversion, rollback, and the 27 host-key columns.review: grok/grok-4.7 GREEN

The 27 host-key columns are switched to `ids.host_keys` with the specified nullability and indexes, while Vaulter entity references stay on the ID strategy. Migration №3 preserves the v0.2 fixture rows (bigint owners `1/2/3` and the three ULIDs), is a no-op on a second run, restores `bigint` or `character` on `--step=1`, and leaves those rows unchanged when a ULID-to-bigint cast fails. The fresh-panel V23 path round-trips the UUID user, bigint project, and Spatie role on PostgreSQL, and the negative control still fails with `SQLSTATE 22001` on `char(26)`. The MySQL 8 `sibling_active` / 1215 failure matches the unchanged-HEAD baseline and stays with P8.1. The separate MySQL host-key DDL run covers all 27 columns, values, nullability, indexes, four target types, idempotency, and `down()`.
